snippet.title: WILDERDARK | Midsummer Night's Scream: A HORROR GAME AWARDS SHOWCASE 2026
snippet.description:
Something dangerous is lurking in the wilderness. Wilderdark is a first-person survival horror game where you must navigate a strange island inhabited by ectoparasitic dinosaurs and organisms. You must remain vigilant to stealthily obtain evidence, samples, and craft tools to survive.

Wishlist Wilderdark on Steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2735850/Wilderdark/

Keep up with Team Junkfish news and updates on our games by following our socials:

Originally aired during MIDSUMMER NIGHT'S SCREAM: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Monday 1 June 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
